text.en:
LEGAL PROFESSION ACT (CHAPTER 132)

NOTIFICATION MADE UNDER SECTION 1 S 41/2003 2006 Edition

REVISED EDITION 2022

LAWS OF BRUNEI Legal Profession CAP. 132, N 3 3 [Subsidiary]

SUBSIDIARY LEGISLATION Notification made under section 1 In exercise of the powers conferred by section 1, His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan has appointed the 1st day of August 2003, as the date on which sections 62 and 63 and Schedule 1 shall come into operation.
